title: The Reading Noble
description: Elend Venture notices Vin standing alone at a balcony during a ball at his own keep and excuses himself to share it with her. He irritates her by pulling out Trials of Monument and reading while the rest of the nobility dances and schemes around them.

title: An Evening with Valette
description: Elend attends the ball at Keep Elariel where he sits at a table with Vin, reading as usual. He compliments her dress, making her jaw drop.

title: The Handkerchief
description: Elend finds Vin at the ball at Keep Hasting. She confronts him about whether he has ever slept with a skaa woman. He confesses that his father forced him to once at the age of thirteen, and the woman was killed afterward—but he never did it again. He gives Vin a handkerchief, signaling his wish to court her. After leaving with his friends, they ascend a tower to discuss the Lord Ruler's faults and what their generation should do about it.

title: Ball at Keep Lekal
description: Elend surprises Vin at the ball at Keep Lekal. He says he wants to kiss her, but Vin insists he doesn't truly know her. They take a stroll instead, and Elend reveals that House Venture's fortune comes entirely from mining atium at the Pits of Hathsin—trusting her completely with this secret. He also mentions the Tekiels were killed by House Hasting, and tries to convince Valette to leave Luthadel for her safety.

title: Father's Summons
description: Elend returns to Keep Venture and tries to sneak past his father's room. Lord Straff Venture, a Tineye who misses nothing, calls him in. Straff tells Elend he must dine with House Hastings and one of their daughters the next day, as he intends to form an alliance with Lord Tegas. Later, Jastes arrives and reveals he had Lady Valette's carriage followed—it arrived in Fellise with only the Terrisman inside, Valette having vanished. Jastes is convinced she is a spy from another house. Elend, realizing he revealed the atium mining secret, proposes a trade to his father: he'll attend the luncheon in exchange for a couple of spies to follow Valette.

title: The Venture Ball
description: Elend is having dinner with his father at Keep Venture during the ball. Vin gets his attention and they have a confrontation. Elend says things hurt Vin, however when Vin learns the there will be an assassin attemp on Elend's life that event she rushes out into the mist to locate the assassins. The evening ends in chaos when Vin fights and kills Lady Shan Elariel, a mistborn, sent to kill Elend. In the turmoil however, Elend is able to slip away.

title: The Spy Reports
description: Elend and Jastes meet with Felt, who recounts everything Elend's spies have discovered about Clubs' shop and those in it. After Felt and Jastes leave, Venture guards take Elend to his father Straff, who reveals that Shan Elariel was a Mistborn sent to assassinate Elend. Elend now knows that a skaa thieving group operates near Keep Venture—and that Valette is connected to them.

title: The Execution Carts
description: Elend sees the Renoux servants caged in an execution cart at Fountain Square. He screams after Valette but cannot find her anywhere in the crowd.

title: Kelsier Saves Elend
description: Elend reaches Renoux's cage at Fountain Square and asks after Valette. An Inquisitor lands on the cage and is about to strike Elend with its axe when Kelsier strikes the Inquisitor, saving Elend's life. Kelsier screams to Elend that Valette is fine, and Elend is dragged away by his bodyguards.

title: Authority of House Venture
description: Elend's father tells him a skaa rebellion has begun and wants to flee Luthadel. Elend refuses to leave. Straff agrees, hoping Elend will be killed, and hands him the authority of House Venture. Elend orders his soldiers to Keep Lekal to join forces in mutual defense against the skaa. He then takes his five best soldiers as an honor guard and goes to turn himself in to the skaa leadership.

title: Rescuing Vin
description: Elend offers gold to some skaa to be brought to Dockson, telling him that House Venture will not resist the rebellion and they should work together. Later, Elend and six soldiers burst into Kredik Shaw to rescue Vin. The secret is out—he now knows Vin is a Mistborn. Vin grabs his head and kisses him, then turns to go kill the Lord Ruler.

title: The Philosopher King
description: In the aftermath of the Lord Ruler's death, Elend emerges as a unifying voice calling for order. He begins meeting with both skaa and noble leaders to draft a code of law for the new nation.

title: The New King
description: Elend Venture is accepted as King of the Central Dominance after a tremendous speech to skaa and noble leaders. He sits at Keep Venture writing the new code of law for the kingdom. Vin secretly watches him from the mists through the window before dashing to him — they hold each other.

title: King on the Walls
description: Elend stands on the city walls of Luthadel watching as fifty thousand soldiers under his father Straff Venture arrive and set camp outside the city. The siege of Luthadel has begun.

title: Writing the Law
description: Elend works in his study at Keep Venture, drafting proposals for the Assembly. Vin joins him after her encounter with the mist spirit, and Ham arrives with intelligence suggesting King Cett sent the Allomancer assassins.

title: The Scholar King
description: Elend works in his study at Keep Venture with Dockson, managing the logistics of a besieged city. Vin joins him after acquiring OreSeur's new wolfhound body.

title: Watching from the Balcony
description: Elend watches Vin spar with Ham in Keep Venture's courtyard. He loses a bet with Clubs about the outcome and reflects on the strengths of his crew.

title: The Assembly
description: Elend addresses the Assembly he created, advocating for democratic principles. A Terriswoman named Tindwyl watches from the audience. The session is interrupted by news that a second army—King Cett's forces—has arrived outside Luthadel.

title: Surveying the Siege
description: Elend stands on the city walls with Clubs and Vin, surveying Cett's newly arrived army to the west alongside his father Straff's forces to the north. Breeze is endangered in an Allomantic confrontation below, and Vin saves him with a duralumin-enhanced Steelpush.

title: War Council
description: Elend gathers the old crew at Keep Venture for a war council to discuss the dual siege. Afterward, Tindwyl approaches him and offers—forcefully—to tutor him in the ways of kingship.

title: A King's Education
description: Tindwyl begins her forceful tutoring of Elend at Keep Venture, reshaping his wardrobe, posture, and bearing. She insists a king must look and act the part if he is to hold power.

title: A King's Transformation
description: Elend stands atop the city walls surveying the besieging armies digging in. Clubs meets him on the wall. Tindwyl sends for him, cuts his hair, gives him a military uniform and a crown - transforming the philosopher into a warrior king.

title: Straff's Messenger
description: Elend, Vin, and OreSeur go to meet a messenger from Straff Venture who turns out to be Zane. Zane states that Straff would host a meeting in his camp. Elend says he will consider the offer.

title: Planning the Parley
description: Elend discusses his plan to parlay with Straff with Dockson, Hammond, Clubs, and Breeze at Keep Venture. He intends to play Straff and Cett against each other. Tindwyl lectures him on kingly mannerisms. Lord Cett's daughter Allrianne arrives seeking asylum.

title: Allrianne's Asylum
description: Allrianne Cett arrives at the palace and embraces Breeze to everyone's surprise. Elend offers her hospitality while the crew debates using her as a bargaining chip against Lord Cett.

title: Fighting for Democracy
description: Elend faces mounting opposition in the Assembly as fear of the siege drives many to seek a stronger leader than a philosopher-king.

title: Sazed's Warning
description: Sazed returns to report twenty thousand koloss under Jastes Lekal approaching Luthadel. The crew debates contingency plans for a third besieging force. Sazed warns that the mists themselves may present a grave danger and are killing people.

title: The Feint Attack
description: Straff launches a feint attack against Luthadel's walls to test the city's defenses. Elend's soldiers are ill-prepared, but the attack is called off quickly. The probe reveals weaknesses in the city's readiness.

title: Parley with Father
description: Elend rides out to Straff Venture's camp to negotiate, bringing Vin as his protector. The meeting reveals Straff's contempt for his idealistic son.

title: Outwitting Straff
description: Straff calls for soldiers to kill Elend during the parley, but Elend bluffs that Vin will destroy the camp if he dies. The gambit works - Straff lets them leave. On the return to Luthadel, Elend receives a devastating note: the Assembly has voted no confidence and he is no longer king.

title: Plotting Diplomacy
description: Back at Keep Venture, Elend attempts to play the three armies against each other—Straff, Cett, and the approaching koloss horde.

title: Chancellor Penrod
description: Elend arrives at the Assembly with his full crew. He nominates Lord Penrod as Assembly Chancellor to preside over meetings in the absence of a king, and addresses the Assembly about his meeting with Straff—invoking Vin's reputation as a deterrent. Nominations for a new king are opened: Penrod, Elend, and Lord Cett, who appears from the crowd.

title: Cett's Gambit
description: Lord Cett addresses the Assembly, arguing his army and Elend's combined forces can hold off the besiegers and promising rewards to those who support him. The Assembly grants Cett an abandoned keep and one thousand soldiers for protection. Cett's son Gneorndin invites Elend to parlay in one week.

title: The Poisoned Well
description: Elend investigates a case of mass illness and discovers one of the city wells has been poisoned. He dispatches Hammond's soldiers to assist the sick and begins searching for the saboteur.

title: Research and Strategy
description: Elend works in Keep Venture's library with Hammond, Sazed, Tindwyl, and the former obligator Noorden, planning strategy for the Assembly and how to prevent Cett from being appointed king. Sazed advises him to focus on his own convictions rather than popular opinion.

title: Dining with Cett
description: Elend and Vin go to Keep Hasting to dine with Lord Cett. Over dinner, they discuss Breeze and Allrianne's defection, Cett's plans for Luthadel, and the missing atium cache. Cett offers food in exchange for the atium but Elend says it hasn't been found. Cett lets Elend leave, seeing no value in him as a hostage.

title: Patrolling the Wall
description: Elend and Hammond patrol the city wall, discussing Elend's desire to remain king to protect the people of Luthadel. Elend has an insight on how he can secure enough votes to avoid being replaced by the Assembly.

title: Deposed
description: Elend attends the Assembly for the king election, having joined the Church of the Survivor to sway skaa votes. Assassins attack during the proceedings—Vin fights them off but is severely injured. The Assembly reconvenes at Penrod's mansion, where Penrod is elected king with a two-thirds majority. Elend concedes.

title: At Vin's Bedside
description: Elend sits beside Vin's hospital bed at Keep Venture, telling her Penrod is the new king. He flinches involuntarily when she touches him, shaken by the ferocity with which she killed the assassins.

title: Seeking Counsel
description: Elend visits Sazed and Tindwyl at Keep Venture, deliberating on his failures to protect Luthadel. They debate why he lost his throne, but both applaud him for sticking to his ideals.

title: Mission to the Koloss
description: Elend and Hammond use a passwall to leave Luthadel. Elend finds Jastes Lekal's koloss army and demands he withdraw, but Jastes insists he is in control. Elend stabs Jastes and uses him as a hostage to escape, then kills a koloss and discovers they carry currency.

title: Finding Vin
description: Elend, Hammond, and Spook discuss why Vin attacked Cett's keep. Hammond reveals Vin has been keeping secrets and working with another Mistborn. OreSeur leads Elend to Vin at Camon's former lair, where she speaks of leaving Luthadel for Terris.

title: Return from the Koloss
description: Elend returns from the koloss camp having failed to negotiate—Jastes lost control of his beasts. The koloss will attack regardless.

title: Departure Through the Tin Gate
description: As Elend prepares to leave for the Well, Tindwyl berates him for abandoning his people and questions his belief in the Well's power. He angrily orders her away but agrees to deliver a package to the Synod in Tathingdwen. With Spook and Allrianne joining them, Elend's party rides out through the Tin Gate, evading Straff's army with Vin's help.

title: The Journey North
description: Elend, Vin, and Spook break camp a day north of Luthadel, believing they have slipped past Straff's scouts. Spook senses something trailing them, and Vin names it the mist spirit. Their certainty about the Well's location in the mountains begins to waver.

title: Executing Jastes
description: The five men trailing the party turn out to be Jastes Lekal, who abandoned the koloss when his counterfeit currency burned and he lost control of them. Furious that Jastes left the beasts to ravage Luthadel unchecked, Elend executes his old friend. When Spook reveals that Sazed deceived them into leaving, the group resolves to return.

title: Turning Back
description: While Vin races ahead on a pewter drag, Elend and Spook ride hard for Luthadel, unable to match her Allomantic speed but determined to reach the besieged city and aid any survivors of the koloss assault.

title: Refugees from Tathingdwen
description: On the road, Elend encounters the mist spirit, which points north and tries to push him before vanishing. He and Spook meet a group of Terris refugees fleeing Tathingdwen, where Steel Inquisitors slaughtered the Synod. Elend accompanies them toward Luthadel, trusting that Vin has somehow prevailed.

title: Emperor's Return
description: Elend, Hammond, and Spook enter Luthadel among a crowd of refugees and meet Vin, who tells him he is now Emperor. Shedding his misgivings about governing, he follows Vin toward Kredik Shaw, where she believes the Well of Ascension lies hidden.

title: To the Well
description: Elend descends with Vin, Hammond, and Spook into the caverns beneath Kredik Shaw, finding a storage cache and a metal map of the Final Empire with Statlin City circled. At the glowing Well, he picks up a small bead of metal set in clay—then the mist spirit stabs him through the gut as Marsh battles Sazed above.

title: The Mistborn Emperor
description: Stabbed and dying at the Well, Elend is saved when Vin forces the bead of the Lord Ruler's metal into his mouth, transforming him into a Mistborn.

title: On the City Wall
description: Newly a Mistborn and confirmed Emperor of the Central Dominance, Elend stands with Vin atop the Luthadel city wall. As she despairs over having freed the thing imprisoned at the Well, he reassures her that they will endure whatever comes—even as the mists begin to linger into daylight, casting a shadow over their hard-won victory.

title: Emperor at War
description: Elend leads his armies to Vetitan, now a Mistborn emperor directing military campaigns to secure the Lord Ruler's hidden supply caches.

title: Securing the Cache
description: Elend secures the Vetitan storage cavern, finding food and a metal plate message warning about the danger Rashek imprisoned and the location of the Fadrex cache.

title: The Canal Camp
description: Elend explains to Fatren that exposing refugees to the mists is necessary — the survivors are now inoculated. He and Vin lead the refugees to a canal where Demoux's forces are bivouacked. Elend orders the refugees escorted to Luthadel and two task forces back to Vetitan to retrieve the supplies.
placementNote: ⚠️ Placed south west of Luthadel — the chapter places them at a canal between Vetitan and Luthadel, not within the city itself.

title: Marching West
description: Elend leads his army south of Luthadel on the march toward Fadrex when Sazed, Breeze, Goradel, and Allrianne rejoin them after their diplomatic mission. Sazed shares his deepening depression over Tindwyl's death with the crew.
placementNote: ⚠️ Placed south west of Luthadel on the route toward Fadrex as a best guess — the chapter only says they meet up with the army, not the exact location.

title: What Would Kelsier Do?
description: Elend convenes a council with Vin, Cett, Breeze, Allrianne, Hammond, Demoux, and Sazed. They discuss the encroaching mists, food shortages, and plans to capture the storage caches. Elend proposes exposing the army to the mists on the march to Fadrex to inoculate them — then asks the crew 'What would Kelsier do?' to reignite their hope and resolve.
placementNote: ⚠️ Placed south west of Luthadel on the march toward Fadrex — the army council is held en route, not in any city.

title: Debating Exposure
description: Elend and Hammond debate the pros and cons of exposing the soldiers to the mists as the army continues its westward march. When Human the koloss causes a disturbance, Elend sends Vin to deal with him. The koloss's unsettling words — that the mists hate both him and Vin — give Elend further reason to doubt the mists' intentions.
placementNote: ⚠️ Placed south west of Luthadel on the march toward Fadrex — the army remains en route.

title: The Mist Exposure
description: Elend orders his soldiers exposed to the mists under controlled conditions so they are immunized for future battles. Demoux confronts him — asking him not to speak in the Survivor's name unless he is a true believer, insisting Kelsier was granted divine power. Elend watches as soldiers begin to fall sick, including Demoux himself.
placementNote: ⚠️ Placed south west of Luthadel on the march toward Fadrex — the army remains en route.

title: The Sixteen Percent
description: Demoux survives his sickness. Elend confides to Vin that he fears he is becoming ruthless like the Lord Ruler for exposing his soldiers to the mists — and second-guesses his own law outlawing the beating of noble children to Snap them. Noorden presents mist sickness reports; Vin questions his methodology and has him recalculate using only soldiers never before exposed. The result: exactly sixteen percent. A second sample matches to the nearest whole person. A third and fourth produce the same ratio with zero margin of error. Elend admits the pattern is too precise to ignore — something intelligent is behind it.

title: The Siege of Fadrex
description: Elend's army arrives at Fadrex and establishes siege lines on the ash-covered plains. He surveys the natural rock formations, the lack of trees, and the canyon-like entrance — this city will be difficult to assault. He debates strategy with Hammond, Cett, and Vin: remain vigilant for raids, send spies, sabotage food supplies, but do not assassinate Yomen. Elend offers to accompany Vin on her scouting mission; she tells him bluntly he isn't good enough.

title: Awaiting the Scout
description: Elend remains at the siege camp while Vin infiltrates Fadrex alone. Though this chapter follows Vin through the city, Elend's trust in her abilities is the quiet cornerstone — he waits, hoping she returns with intelligence that can spare them from a bloody assault.

title: The Mist Spirit and the Prophecy
description: Vin returns from scouting and tells Elend she sensed the Mist Spirit inside Fadrex — it is much weaker than Ruin but opposes him. She speaks of her destiny as the Hero of Ages, but Elend warns the prophecies could have been corrupted by Ruin. They reaffirm their trust: Vin cannot share her plans aloud for fear Ruin will learn them, but she urges Elend to investigate the sixteen-percent anomaly circumspectly. Elend resolves to use his army only as a last resort — and Vin proposes a bolder path: crash one of Yomen's balls and speak to him directly.

title: The First Ball
description: Elend is surprised that no one objects to him and Vin placing themselves in danger — and delineates the line of succession to Lord Cett just in case. They travel to the ball at Keep Orielle, handing a servant their names and titles, and are announced to the attendees. They split up to mingle before confronting Yomen directly. Elend watches from across the room as Vin begins to work the noble crowd.

title: Patterns of Sixteen
description: Elend accepts Cett's advice to poison Fadrex's water wells and intimidate outlying villages — but draws the line at killing innocents. An earthquake rattles the camp, a reminder that time is short. Demoux recovers from his mist sickness but asks to be relieved as general, believing Kelsier has judged him unworthy. He reveals a new statistical anomaly: one sixteenth of the sick either remain ill for exactly sixteen days or perish — another sixteen, like the mist sickness rate. Elend refuses the resignation and orders Demoux to stop pitying himself and apply scientific reasoning instead. They are interrupted by shouting outside.

title: Yomen's Gambit
description: Yomen's night raid on the camp proves to be a devastating diversion: while Vin chased a mysterious Mistborn through the city, Yomen deployed heavy siege equipment and annihilated half of Elend's twenty thousand koloss. He transfers control of a thousand survivors to Vin — but the siege has just become far more desperate.

title: The Third Art
description: Elend, Hammond, Cett, Noorden, and Demoux work through the evidence together: the spikes Human used, Marsh's description of Inquisitor creation, the hunting of skaa Mistings. Elend connects the pieces — koloss are made from humans, and the same Hemalurgic process creates Inquisitors and kandra. They theorize all three share the same weakness to emotional Allomancy, exploited by their true enemy. Hearing that mistfallen soldiers are shunned by their comrades, Elend orders Demoux to form them into a new division. Conrad arrives from Luthadel: Penrod begs for aid as food riots consume the capital. Elend sees patterns in Ruin's attacks and begins to deduce their meaning.

title: A Duel Declined
description: Elend attends the second ball at the Canton of Resource, knowing Vin is slipping away to find the cache. He challenges Yomen to a duel to settle their dispute. Yomen declines — he would be at a fatal disadvantage against a Mistborn. Yomen claims he earned his right to rule; Elend counters that controlling the koloss as the Lord Ruler did makes him the rightful inheritor of the empire. The real purpose is time: Elend keeps Yomen debating as long as possible while Vin works unseen below.

title: Electrum and Atium
description: Elend continues debating Yomen on the Terris Stewardship program until one of the spies Vin incapacitated stumbles in — blowing her cover. Desperate to know if Yomen is a Mistborn, Elend lunges and chokes him. When Yomen doesn't resist, Elend lets go — and Yomen stabs him with unnatural speed, confirming he burns atium. Elend burns electrum, clouding Yomen's atium shadows, and withdraws — surprised Yomen doesn't pursue.

title: The Note
description: Back at the siege camp, Elend waits through the long hours for Vin to return from the storage cache. A note arrives from Yomen — he has captured her. The siege is no longer about supplies. It is personal.

title: Losing Vin
description: Elend stands in the mists worrying about Vin but holding onto faith in her. Lord Cett tells him the siege is failing — they should attack Fadrex, then return to Luthadel. A disturbance interrupts them: mistfallen soldiers, ostracized by their comrades, are brawling with other troops. Elend breaks up the fight, then orders Demoux to march the mistfallen division to Luthadel to assist Penrod — both reinforcing the capital and separating the persecuted soldiers from the main army. He heads to Noorden's tent to devise new siege tactics against Yomen.

title: The Duralumin Gambit
description: Elend uses Steelpushes to travel toward a village being attacked by a koloss army. He fights through them alone, then performs a duralumin-enhanced emotional Pull — seizing control of thirty thousand koloss in a single overwhelming moment. He returns to camp with his new army.

title: Kneeling in Ash
description: Elend walks back to camp with thirty thousand new koloss, collapses in the ash ready to give up. The Mist Spirit appears and kneels beside him. Elend questions it using yes or no — the figure waves its arms for no when Ruin would twist words — and learns the mists are not killing people, it doesn't want him to attack Fadrex, and Ruin is vulnerable. The figure points urgently northeast, then at Elend's metal vial, and whispers that they maybe can survive before vanishing. The encounter revigorates him, though he doesn't understand why.

title: The Morning Assault
description: Elend arrives back at camp with thirty thousand new koloss and tells Hammond that Vin is still alive — her bonded koloss haven't lost control, which means Yomen hasn't executed her. Hammond reports grim news from scouts: Luthadel and many villages across the Central Dominance are devastated, some cities destroyed outright by earthquakes and lava flows. With Vin's life hanging in the balance and the world crumbling around them, Elend orders Hammond to plan a surprise attack for the morning with the koloss leading the way.

title: Retreat into Fadrex
description: Elend asks Hammond if attacking the city is right — it isn't — and orders the camp packed up for a return to Luthadel. When Yomen's inferior force charges out, Elend grows suspicious and orders the koloss to fall back. Before he can act, Ruin seizes control of all koloss from him. His army is attacked by the very creatures they commanded moments before. Vin arrives and orders a desperate retreat into Fadrex City, forging a temporary alliance with Yomen against their common enemy.

title: Watching the Gathering Storm
description: Elend and Yomen watch from inside Fadrex as an enormous army of koloss gathers outside. A gigantic earthquake rocks the city. Vin tells Elend she must leave for Luthadel to get the atium cache, hoping to draw Ruin away.

title: The Secret of the Mists
description: Elend tours the city with Yomen and visits the infirmary. Watching a mist-sick boy in agony, he realizes the experience mirrors the beatings used to Snap Allomancers. He gives a mistfallen soldier an Allomantic vial—and the man can burn metals. The mists are not killing people; they are Snapping them into Allomancers. Ruin sends the koloss to attack before Elend can act on the discovery.

title: The Mists Move
description: Elend and Hammond notice a sudden change in the mists — instead of their usual chaotic swirling, they are flowing purposefully, all toward Luthadel. Before they can puzzle out what this means, the koloss army they have been battling abruptly withdraws, also heading for the capital. Something fundamental has shifted — and Elend knows Vin is at the heart of it.

title: The Seer Revealed
description: Elend and Yomen discuss the sudden disappearance of the mists and the unusual, oppressive heat. Elend orders everyone in Fadrex to gather inside the storage caverns for protection. Yomen presses his own bead of atium into Elend's hand and reveals he is a Seer — an atium misting, one of the sixteen kinds the Lord Ruler kept secret. Elend now carries Yomen's atium and a new understanding of the pattern of sixteen.

title: Flying Toward Luthadel
description: Elend leaves Fadrex behind and begins the journey to Luthadel. He travels as Vin once taught him — dropping a horseshoe, Steelpushing off it to launch himself into the air, then Pulling another anchor to repeat the cycle. Flying across the ashen landscape alone, he races eastward carrying Yomen's atium bead and hoping he will find Vin alive at the end of the road.
placementNote: ⚠️ The book never specifies which route Elend takes from Fadrex to Luthadel. Placed east of Fadrex as a best guess.

title: Bound for Luthadel
description: Still crossing the Central Dominance toward Luthadel, Elend pushes on through the ashen wilderness — dropping a horseshoe, Steelpushing off it, then pulling another anchor, eating up the miles as Vin once taught him. He carries Yomen's atium bead and the desperate hope that he will find Vin alive when he reaches the capital.
placementNote: ⚠️ Placed west of Luthadel on the approach from Fadrex — the book only says Vin sees him heading toward the capital, not his exact position.

title: Riding into Luthadel
description: Elend rides into Luthadel from the west, entering the capital he once ruled as king. High above, unseen by him, Vin — newly ascended as Preservation — watches the man she loves arrive in the city, alone and determined.

title: Ruins of Kredik Shaw
description: Elend searches through the ruins of Kredik Shaw — Vin demolished it with a single Push when she Ascended, and the Lord Ruler's thousand-year-old palace is now a field of rubble. He picks through the debris calling her name, but Luthadel is empty. The people have vanished into the storage caverns, and Vin is nowhere among the broken stones. He does not yet know she floats above him, watching — and that Ruin is blocking every attempt she makes to speak.

title: The Whisper in the Wind
description: Elend searches Keep Venture and finds King Penrod's corpse — the man Marsh spiked for Ruin, now dead among the ashes of the fallen capital. He tries to piece together where the people of Luthadel have gone. Then he hears it: the wind, whispering his name. Vin expends a monumental effort to speak a single word through Ruin's interference. 'West,' she breathes. 'Pits.' Elend mounts up and rides west toward the Pits of Hathsin, not knowing what waits for him there — only that Vin is calling.

title: Arrival at the Pits
description: Elend arrives at the Pits of Hathsin and finds Demoux and the mistfallen soldiers already there. Hundreds of thousands of refugees have gathered—they came because Kelsier told them to. Elend orders the mistfallen to consume Allomantic metals.

title: The Refugees
description: Demoux reports that several hundred thousand refugees have gathered at the Pits — and a koloss army is marching toward them. There are no walls, no defenses. When Elend asks why they came, Demoux answers: because Kelsier told them to. Elend questions the eyewitnesses who claim to have seen the Survivor but cannot decide whether to believe them. Then he hears his name whispered on the wind — Vin's voice — and follows it through the camp toward the Homeland.

title: The Atium Hoard
description: Guided by Vin's whisper, Elend finds the entrance to the kandra caverns. Inside he discovers Sazed — the Keeper has been fighting alone, using his metalminds to hold a doorway against KanPaar's renegade kandra who tried to steal the atium. Sazed tells him the hoard is here: an immense cache of atium, Ruin's own body. Elend subdues the remaining kandra, but his mind is on the people outside. He orders everyone — refugees, soldiers, kandra — to take shelter in the caverns before the koloss army and the sunrise arrive.

title: The Last Speech
description: Sazed reveals the truth: the atium is Ruin's body, and if Ruin recovers it the world ends. Demoux reports that all his mistfallen soldiers consumed metals but none showed Allomantic ability — until Elend hands Demoux an atium bead and watches him burn it. They are all Seers, atium mistings. Elend gives a speech to his small band, dons his mistcloak, and leads them charging out of the caverns toward the koloss army as Vin watches from above.

title: Dying Well
description: Elend burns through a vast quantity of atium for hours, the Seers at his side cutting through thousands of koloss. When his pewter runs out, somehow he can still burn it — he looks up and sees Vin. Then Marsh appears, also burning atium, a dark force guiding his movements. Elend burns duralumin and atium together in a final moment of perfect clarity: he sees the world as a god might, understands everything. He drives his sword into Marsh's neck as Marsh's axe takes him in the chest. Marsh claims victory — but Elend whispers that he is wrong. Every last bead of atium has been burned. Ruin will never recover his body. Elend dies smiling.

title: Reunited in Death
description: Elend's body is found beside Vin's in the field of flowers—Sazed's first gift to the remade world—at peace after all their struggles.
placementNote: ⚠️ Approximate placement — after the Catacendre, the world has been completely remade. Old landmarks no longer exist. This is the field of flowers and green grass where Vin and Elend are found.
